title: BMUnun to the rector of Indianyn Krdagy elchisi menen rasmiy zholugushuu otkordu

blocks.text: Bishkek Mamlekettik University Rector, Professor Mirlan Dyldaev Kyrgyz Republic Syndagy India Republic son atayin zhana yigarym ukuktuu elchisi Birender Singh Yadav myrza menen India elchiliginde zholugushuu otkordү.

Zholugushuunun zүrүshүndө taraptar India өkmөtү tarabynan sunushtalgan bilim beru programlary boyuncha pikir almashyshyp, eki olkonun zhogorku bilim beru mekemeleri ortosundagy kyzmattashtykty Myndan ary terendetu mүmkүnchүlүktөrun talkuulashty. Oshondoy ele Kyrgyzstan menen Indianyn ortosundagy dostuk zhana oz ara tүshүnүsүү mamilelerin onүkturүүnүn maanisi belgilenip, madaniy zhana academylyk baylanyshtardy chyңdoo maseleleri karaldy.
Bul zholugushuu eki taraptuu kyzmattashtyktyn myndan ary keneyishine chon salym koshooru kutuluүdo.
